name.zh: 武器与狂怒 Beta 开荒

summary.zh: 11 点全投狂怒系：5% 近战暴击、持续不断的额外怒气，以及 20 级的刺耳怒吼，逃跑的怪一个也跑不掉。
summary.en: Eleven points into Fury: 5% melee critical strike, a steady stream of extra Rage, and Piercing Howl at 20 to stop anything that runs.

scenario.zh: 10–20 级，武器与狂怒在 Beta 等级上限下共用的起手
scenario.en: Levels 10–20, the opening Arms and Fury share at the beta level cap

pros.zh: 残忍提供 5% 近战暴击几率，是武器系深层天赋开放之前最直接的伤害提升。
pros.en: Cruelty adds 5% melee critical strike chance, the simplest damage increase available before the deeper Arms talents open.

pros.zh: 怒不可遏让近战伤害有 60% 几率额外产生 1 点怒气，怒气消耗技能因此能连续使用。
pros.en: Unbridled Wrath gives melee damage a 60% chance of 1 extra Rage, which is what keeps your Rage spenders coming.

pros.zh: 20 级的刺耳怒吼让周围敌人昏乱 6 秒，移动速度降低 50%：拉怪失手时可以脱身，也能留住逃跑的怪。
pros.en: Piercing Howl at level 20 dazes every nearby enemy for 6 seconds: an escape when a pull goes wrong, and a way to finish runners.

pros.zh: 这个等级段武器与狂怒需要的 11 点完全相同，因此本方案同时适用；20 级之后两系才会分开。
pros.en: Arms and Fury want the same eleven points at this level, so this build covers both; the trees separate after level 20.

pros.zh: 想进地下城坦克？防护方案把这些点数全部换成格挡回怒。
pros.en: Tanking dungeons instead? The Protection build trades all of this for Rage on every block.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425 recommendations; may change before launch.
